close_reason: Superseded by the atomic implementation boundary fz-5xp.30; all valid acceptance criteria moved into that description.
description:
## Status

Invalid architecture. The proposed typed-intrinsic subsystem is rejected: it would turn the ordinary runtime foreign boundary into compiler-owned hidden machinery.

No implementation from this ticket may land. Its former requirements are not absorbed by fz-5xp.30 as written before the redesign.

fz-5xp.30 now owns only the truthful private FFI cutover: extern defp visibility, exact runtime export names, generic C and fz ABI lowering, typed ABI lanes, and spawn_opt deletion. Arithmetic and comparison declarations must be audited after that cutover: a real C export remains an ordinary private extern; a fake extern must move to the existing typed language or IR operator authority in a separately justified plan.
title: Absorbed into fz-5xp.30
